message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to weather data, so I can’t give you the current conditions in San Francisco.  
Here are a few ways you can check the latest weather:

| Method | How to use it |
|--------|---------------|
| **Weather websites** | Visit sites like [weather.com](https://weather.com), [AccuWeather](https://www.accuweather.com), or the National Weather Service’s page for San Francisco. |
| **Mobile apps** | Most smartphones come with a built‑in weather app. You can also download dedicated apps such as Weather Underground, Dark Sky (now integrated into Apple Weather), or the NOAA Weather Radar Live app. |
| **Voice assistants** | Ask Siri, Google Assistant, or Alexa: “What’s the weather in San Francisco?” |
| **API** | If you’re building an application, you can use a weather API (e.g., OpenWeatherMap, WeatherAPI, or the NOAA API) to fetch current conditions programmatically. |

If you need a quick snapshot right now, just type “San Francisco weather” into your search engine and the top result will show the current temperature, forecast, and any alerts.
